description: WaveX: A Dataset for Freeway Stop-and-Go Wave Super-Resolution Reconstruction is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Junyi Ji, Alex Richardson (Vanderbilt University). Overview WaveX dataset collected from Tennessee Department of Transportation I-24 MOTION testbed, released with research article Stop-and-go wave super-resolution reconstruction via iterative refinement published at Transportation Research Part C. Data Collection The dataset was collected from I-24 MOTION testbed and I-24 SMART Corridor in Nashville, Tennessee, U.S., from May 17 to July 17, 2024. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
